key_insight: A physics-constrained, data-driven reduced-order modeling framework enables efficient aerodynamic shape optimization of unsteady flapping wings.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce the computational and memory demands of optimizing wing shapes for improved thrust and propulsive efficiency.
method: Reformulate PDE-constrained optimization as ROM-constrained optimization.
Project optimization into system dynamics in Hilbert space to improve sensitivity stability.
evidence_signal: For a 2D flapping wing section at Re = 2,400, the study reports 37% higher time-averaged thrust and 40% higher propulsive efficiency; a 3D wing case was also tested.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify computational savings or 3D performance gains, leaving scalability to complex designs uncertain.
paper_title: Aerodynamic Shape Optimization of unsteady flapping wings
